prompts.prompt: Documentary editorial photograph of a coastal guide at Qixingtan, Hualien. A compact sturdy Han Taiwanese woman in her late forties, hair tied back under a knitted beanie against the cold, a red windbreaker over a fleece, a head torch round her neck, wet boots. She stands square on the shifting grey pebbles with one arm held out flat and low, holding her group back from an incoming surge of surf, head turned to speak to them and side-on to the low sun so her face is lit rather than backlit, loose hair whipped across her cheek by the onshore wind. The grey pebble bank of Qixingtan, the Qingshui Cliffs headland running north behind her, dawn light, cold blue shadow between the stones. Wide 16:9 frame, waist-up and close, subject slightly right of centre, head in the upper-middle third, empty pebbles and surf in the lower-left, plain sky and headland in the upper-right. 50mm lens, f/2.8, background soft, the woman unmistakably the subject.

GENDER — 40 total: 24 male / 16 female (40% female).
Drivers (20): 17 male, 3 female (p-xiaofang 小芳, p-yehliu-car 北海岸, p-luodong-car 羅東冬山) = 15% female, skewed male but not exclusive.
Guides (20): 7 male, 13 female. Name-locked female: 秀珠, 怡君, 淑玲, 佩瑜, 郁婷, 秀蘭, 雅萍, 美玲. Name-locked male: 阿哲, 阿源, 宗翰, 文彥, 建良, 俊宏. Free choices: 小米 F, Ada F, Panay F, Ina F (Amis "mother"), Lisin F, Sawagu M.

AGE — full trade span, 13 bands, no clumping:
late 20s ×3 (5, 16, 21) | early 30s ×3 (6, 24, 29) | mid 30s ×4 (4, 14, 20, 35) | late 30s ×3 (1, 30, 32) | early 40s ×4 (10, 13, 23, 36) | mid 40s ×5 (2, 8, 19, 27, 37) | late 40s ×3 (7, 33, 39) | early 50s ×4 (0, 18, 22, 38) | mid 50s ×3 (11, 26, 34) | late 50s ×3 (9, 15, 31) | early 60s ×2 (3, 12) | mid 60s ×2 (17, 28) | late 60s ×1 (25). Real 60-somethings: 府城 driver 早60s, 阿源 早60s, 港都 mid 60s, Ina mid 60s, 池上小巴 late 60s. Real late 20s: 阿凱, 宗翰, 佩瑜.

HERITAGE — 28 Han Taiwanese, 12 Indigenous Taiwanese, all geographically honest: Truku at 秀林/新城 (10 Panay, 31 太魯閣接駁, 38 新城, 39 美玲), Amis at 花蓮市/光復馬太鞍/成功比西里岸 (4, 24, 27, 28, 29, 30), Puyuma at 台東市/卑南 (22, 23). All in 2020s field/working clothing — no ceremonial dress anywhere.

UNIQUENESS CHECK (ageBand + gender + wardrobe + framing) — 40 distinct tuples. The only repeated (ageBand+gender) pairs are separated by wardrobe in every case, e.g. mid 30s M: teal quick-dry (4) vs orange long-sleeve (20) vs charcoal polo (35); mid 40s M: black windbreaker (2) vs grey windbreaker (19) vs open navy shirt (27); early 60s M: pale blue button shirt (3) vs brown canvas jacket (12); late 30s F: grey quick-dry (1) vs rubber waders (30) vs sky-blue shirt (32).

WARDROBE — 40 distinct garments across polo, quick-dry, windbreaker, fleece, gilet, fishing vest, field vest, waders, work shirt, uniform shirt, linen shirt, hoodie, denim shirt, railway jacket, canvas jacket, sun sleeves, farm hat, headcloth, beanie, bucket hat, straw hat, mesh cap, visor. Glasses on 6 only (3, 7, 9, 12, 16, 18-pushed-up); sunglasses on 4 (11, 19-collar, 22-none, 27); caps/hats on 11.

SETTINGS — 40 different views, each drawn from that person's own themes and area, no repeats and no two people in the same spot doing the same thing. 東北角 split four ways (九份 pull-in / 陰陽海 overlook / 金瓜石 steps / 平溪 track). 北海岸 split three ways (老梅石槽 / 金山老街 / 野柳 platform). 太魯閣 split three ways (清水斷崖 lay-by / 砂卡礑 walkway / 燕子口 helmets). 花蓮北段 split three ways (芭崎眺望 / 新城天主堂 pre-dawn / 七星潭 pebble waterline) — 七星潭 itself is used once only, by 美玲, and is grey cobbles with the 清水斷崖 headland, never white sand. 縱谷 split (伯朗大道 lane / 大坡池 reeds / 鹿野高台 ridge / 大農大富 avenue / 馬太鞍 channel). 台東海岸 split (金剛大道 ridge road / 三仙台 tide shelf). 台中 split (日月潭 mist / 第二市場 / 梧棲漁港 / 高美濕地 boardwalk).

LIGHT matches stated hours: 04:30 starts are pre-dawn and dawn (28, 38, 39); 06:00–06:30 starts are first light and mist (10, 15, 25, 26, 31); 14:00–19:30 and 夕陽場 are sunset (36, 14, 12); 15:00–23:00 and 夜場 are night-market and lantern light (21, 18, 23, 24, 5). Nine images are dark or low-light, so the sheet is not 40 sunny middays.

ACTIONS — all hands-on and different: opening doors, wiping glass, checking tyres, unloading a bicycle, unloading a cooler, carrying a fish box, pouring tea, handing helmets, handing tea, counting with a clipboard, spreading a map, holding a print, holding a laminated map, torch on tilework, hand on rock, hand on brick, parting reeds, lifting bamboo traps, holding up a shell, holding up a cobble, walking backwards talking, pausing on steps. No one is simply smiling at camera.

COMPOSITION — every row is 16:9 with the subject centred or right of centre, head in the upper-middle third, and the lower-left plus upper-right explicitly left as plain background for the distance chip and the 「AI 生成」 badge.
